display_name: Combined variable of Respiratory Event Index or Apnea Hypopnea Index from PVDOMICS protocol studies and alternative sleep studies
description: Legacy variable created by the PVDOMICS study team by combining the Respiratory Event Index from the PVDOMICS core study protocol (:ahi_score:) with the Respiratory Event Index or Apnea-Hypopnea Index reported from the alternative studies (:ahi_alt:).
